headline: `03`'s Jordan–Hölder lemma and `08`'s ratio test are the same statement, verified over 22,140 character pairs with 0 mismatches; `10`'s single congruence is the whole of the condition at every good ordinary p >= 5, and NOT at p = 3, because chi_cyc^2 is unramified exactly when p - 1 divides 2. And the corpus disagrees with itself about H3: `02` forbids equating the divisibility criterion with it, `08` and `09` do exactly that. The disagreement is reported, not resolved
